conflicts.subject: removed-member-expenses
conflicts.detail: The user saw a removed member's earlier expenses stay in the budget (my-notes.md:2) and did not say whether that is wanted. Whether the removed member can still see them is unknown. Getting this wrong either changes budget totals retroactively or leaks budget data to someone who was removed.
solutions: Keep the expenses in the budget, mark them 'former member', revoke the removed member's access to the whole budget, and tell the owner before removing
Move the removed member's expenses out of the budget into their personal expenses
Ask the owner at removal time which of the two to do
conflicts.recommended: Keep the expenses in the budget (totals stay right, matching Tallyho), mark them as from a former member, revoke all access for the removed member, and show the owner a confirmation that explains this; offering a choice can come later if the user wants it

resolution.decision: Keep the removed member's expenses in the budget (totals unchanged), mark them as from a former member, revoke all of the removed member's access to the budget and its expenses on every read, and show the owner a confirmation explaining this before removal. A per-removal choice can be added later if the user wants it.

conflicts.subject: money-and-currency
conflicts.detail: Spendly stores amount_cents (integer cents) with no currency; Tallyho stores amount plus currency (shown with decimals, e.g. 12.40 GBP, type undocumented) and converts foreign receipts to a home currency. A budget's 'spent of limit' is shown in one currency. Summing mixed currencies or mixing decimal and integer amounts would give wrong totals.
solutions: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency on every expense and budget; an expense in a budget must be in the budget's currency; conversion deferred (M02)
Integer minor units plus currency, and build conversion now with an exchange-rate provider
Decimal amounts with currency
conflicts.recommended: Integer minor units plus ISO 4217 currency everywhere; an expense added to a budget must match the budget's currency (the scan review asks for the amount in the budget's currency when the receipt differs); conversion stays deferred

resolution.decision: Integer minor units (bigint) plus ISO 4217 currency on every expense and budget; an expense in a budget must be in the budget's currency; when a scanned receipt is in another currency the review screen flags it and asks for the amount in the budget's currency; conversion (M02) stays deferred.

conflicts.subject: invitation-rules
conflicts.detail: Tallyho does not document who may invite, expiry or reuse of invitations; a reusable or non-expiring link would let anyone holding it join a budget and see its expenses.
solutions: Owner-only invites, single-use token, 7-day expiry, accepted only by an account with the invited email
Any member may invite
conflicts.recommended: Owner-only, single-use, 7-day expiry, bound to the invited email

resolution.decision: Owner-only invites; single-use random token stored hashed; 7-day expiry; accepted only by a signed-in account whose verified email matches the invitation.

conflicts.subject: category-on-scanned-expenses
conflicts.detail: Spendly requires one of four categories on every expense; Tallyho's scan fills only merchant, date and total, so a scanned expense has no category from the scan.
solutions: Category is a required choice on the scan review screen, no default
Default scanned expenses to 'other'
Guess the category from the merchant
conflicts.recommended: Required choice on the review screen with no default, so 'other' does not fill up silently; a merchant-based suggestion can come later

resolution.decision: Category is a required choice on the scan review screen with no default; scanning never sets it.

conflicts.subject: monthly-reset-semantics
conflicts.detail: Tallyho documents only that budgets 'reset monthly'; day, time zone, rollover and whether expenses are kept are unknown.
solutions: Spent total covers the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; expenses kept; no rollover; computed at read time
Reset on the budget's creation day each month
Scheduled job that archives and zeroes
conflicts.recommended: Calendar month in the budget's time zone, expenses kept, no rollover, computed at read time

resolution.decision: Spent total = expenses dated in the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; expenses are kept; no rollover; computed at read time. These are the unified app's own rules, not Tallyho's (undocumented).

conflicts.subject: personal-vs-budget-expenses
conflicts.detail: Spendly expenses belong to no one and no budget; Tallyho expenses are listed per budget. The unified app must say where an expense lives and who sees it.
solutions: Every expense has an author; budget is optional; without a budget only the author sees it
Every expense must be in a budget; each user gets a personal budget
conflicts.recommended: Author required, budget optional; a personal expense is visible to its author only

resolution.decision: Every expense has an author; budget is optional; a personal expense is visible to its author only.

conflicts.subject: scanned-date-trust
conflicts.detail: Tallyho's scanned date is often wrong (user's notes); saving it unchecked would put expenses in the wrong month and so the wrong budget period (M07).
solutions: Mark the scanned date for checking and require confirmation; replace missing or implausible dates with today, flagged
Ignore the scanned date and always use today
Trust the scanned date
conflicts.recommended: Mark it for checking and require confirmation; implausible (future or more than 90 days old) or missing dates become today, flagged

resolution.decision: Scanned date shown as 'check this date' and must be confirmed before saving; missing, future or more-than-90-days-old dates are replaced by today and flagged.

conflicts.subject: receipt-images
conflicts.detail: Receipt photos are personal data (may show card digits, addresses); Tallyho's storage and retention are unknown, and sending them to an OCR provider is a data transfer.
solutions: Private object storage, access through the expense's permission check, delete with the expense; OCR provider chosen by the user with a no-retention option, or on-device/self-hosted OCR
Do not keep images after extraction
conflicts.recommended: Private storage behind the expense's permission check, deleted with the expense; OCR provider is the user's choice behind an adapter (decided at implementation, needs their account and keys)

resolution.decision: Receipt images in private storage, served only through the expense's permission check, deleted with the expense; OCR provider behind an adapter, chosen by the user at implementation (their account and keys; prefer a no-retention option). Not decided in plan mode.

conflicts.subject: expense
conflicts.detail: Expense exists in A:Expense, B:Expense; fields not shared: budget_id (only A), currency (only A), date (only A), merchant (only A), note (only B)
solutions: Merge into one table holding the fields kept features need
Keep separate tables if the two only share a name, and rename one
conflicts.recommended: Merge into one entity; list every field's origin in architecture.json

resolution.decision: One Expense entity: id, author_id, budget_id (nullable), amount_minor, currency, spent_on, merchant, category, note, receipt_id, created_at, updated_at; every field's origin in architecture.json.

conflicts.subject: expense.amount
conflicts.detail: Expense.amount type is not known for A
solutions: Read the source's schema or migrations for the type
Record it as unknown and decide in the architecture
conflicts.recommended: Find the real type before designing the merged entity

resolution.decision: Tallyho's type cannot be found (closed, undocumented); not needed because no Tallyho data is imported. Unified type: bigint minor units (Spendly's integer cents).

conflicts.subject: expense.category
conflicts.detail: Expense.category type is not known for A
solutions: Read the source's schema or migrations for the type
Record it as unknown and decide in the architecture
conflicts.recommended: Find the real type before designing the merged entity

resolution.decision: Tallyho's type and values are unknown; its category field is dropped (M10). Unified: text constrained to food, travel, home, other.

conflicts.subject: expense.primary-key
conflicts.detail: Expense primary key type is not known for A, B; find it before deciding the merged key
solutions: Read the source's schema or migrations for the type
Record it as unknown and decide in the architecture
conflicts.recommended: Find the real type before designing the merged entity

resolution.decision: Neither source has a known key (Spendly none, Tallyho undocumented). Unified: uuid generated by the app.
